source_snapshot.items: NVQual - Bluefield-3 PCIE Interface Traffic Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Long traffic validates BER and bandwidth.

old_problem: Path, traffic direction/pattern/rate/duration, BER denominator/limit, bandwidth floor and recovery are missing; Criteria are unrelated.
disposition_reason: BF3 long-duration PCIe traffic purpose is explicit. Exact profile/topology and numeric BER/bandwidth rules are runtime inputs; auxiliary readability/FW do not determine verdict.
decision_basis: Preserved long-duration traffic, BER and bandwidth coverage.

test_case.test_name: BF3 PCIe traffic BER and bandwidth qualification
test_case.purpose: Drive every approved BF3-host path with the signed traffic profile for full duration and verify BER plus bandwidth.
test_case.test_command: Verify topology/profile; isolate services; run full-duration traffic; capture transmitted bits, error counters, per-path bandwidth, link state, AER and health.
test_case.expected_result: Every path completes full duration within signed BER and bandwidth limits with no link/platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output/FW or BER without denominator cannot PASS.
test_case.recovery: Stop traffic, restore services/link state and verify BF3/host health.

source_conflict.reason: BER/bandwidth limits control; readability/FW remain auxiliary.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind profile/path map, BER denominator/limit, bandwidth floor and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; RUNTIME AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED

project_authority: Traffic profile and acceptance are project/vendor-specific.
